name: Trustedge Capital Limited
about: Trustedge Capital Limited, a non-banking finance company, engages in the finance and investment businesses in India. The company offers small and medium enterprise (SME) financing products comprising working capital products, such as purchase and work order finance, invoice discounting, and supply chain finance; and term loan products, including business loans, machinery finance, and loans against property. It also provides corporate financing products consisting of growth capital and margin funding products. In addition, the company is involved in financing activities; and investments in listed shares, debt and equity instruments, and mutual funds. It serves SMEs and entrepreneurs. The company was formerly known as Adinath Exim Resources Limited and changed its name to Trustedge Capital Limited in June 2025. Trustedge Capital Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
